definitions.gloss: compensation; covering a loss; filling a shortfall
definitions.explanation: Making up for a deficit, loss, or shortage, especially financially. Used in business, finance, and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補填|ほてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補填|ほてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Tax money was used to cover the losses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人手|ひとで}{不足|ぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補填|ほてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{雇|やと}った→雇う：02320_yatou⟧。
examples.english: We hired part-time workers to make up for the labor shortage.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly used in business, finance, and government contexts. It implies making up for something that is missing or deficient. The kanji {填|てん} means to fill in.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧{補填|ほてん} (deficit coverage)
- ⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧{補填|ほてん} (loss compensation)
- {財源|ざいげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補填|ほてん} (filling a funding gap)
- ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補填|ほてん} (filling a personnel shortage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{補充|ほじゅう}→補充：14037_hojuu⟧: replenishment — restocking or adding more of something
- ⟦{補償|ほしょう}→補償：03720_hoshou⟧: compensation — making amends for damage or injury
